Baseball.name: Extended sprite: baseball and bone
summary: Main routine for extended sprite $0D (baseball thrown by Chargin' Chuck) and, from CODE_02A2C3, extended sprite $06 (bone thrown by Dry Bones).
Unless sprites are locked: moves by X speed, advances the spin counter [$1765] (1.5 per frame), tests contact with Mario.
Baseball: drawn as one 8x8 tile $AD that spins via flip bits; deleted if off screen and moving away, or off screen vertically.
Bone: uses the shared 16x16 spinning code (CODE_02A317) and picks tile $80 or $82.

HammerTiles.name: Table: hammer and bone spin tiles
summary: 8 spin frames: tile $08 or $6D.

HammerGfxProp.name: Table: hammer spin properties
summary: OAM properties (YXPPCCCT) for the 8 spin frames: flip combinations, palette 3.

Hammer.name: Extended sprite: hammer (and shared 16x16 spinner)
summary: Main routine for extended sprite $04 (hammer thrown by Hammer Bros.) and, via CODE_02A30C, $0B (Piranha Plant fireball).
Moves by X and Y speed, applies gravity (Y speed += 2 until $40), tests contact with Mario, advances the spin counter [$1765].
CODE_02A317 draws a 16x16 sprite using tile and properties tables indexed by [$1765] / 8 (also used by the bone). Piranha fireballs use the Reznor fireball drawing instead.

DustCloudTiles.name: Tables: smoke puff tiles and flips
summary: $02A347: puff tile by age ($66,$64,$60,$62). $02A34B: OAM flip bits (none, X, X+Y, Y).

SmokePuff.name: Extended sprite: smoke puff, contact with Mario
summary: SmokePuff: extended sprite $01. Timer [$176F] counts down; frame = timer / 4 selects a tile from DustCloudTiles, flips rotate with the frame counter. Deleted when the timer is 0 or it is off screen. In some Mode 7 boss rooms it uses OAM slots in the second OAM page.

CODE_02A3F6 (called by the baseball, hammer and Reznor fireball): checks contact with Mario if both are on the same layer. Extended sprite $0A (cloud-game coin): collects the coin, spawns smoke and a score sprite.
Otherwise: with a star, the sprite is turned into a smoke puff (CODE_02A4B5); on Yoshi, Yoshi is knocked away and Mario bounces up; otherwise Mario is hurt.

s02A4B3.name: Table: Yoshi X speed when knocked away
summary: $10 or $F0, indexed by Yoshi's direction.

s02A4B5.name: Turn extended sprite into smoke puff
summary: Used when Mario touches an extended sprite while having a star. Shifts the position up-left by 4 (not for hammers), sets the puff timer to 7 and falls into the next section.

Instr02A4E5.name: Set extended sprite number to 1
summary: Stores 1 in the extended sprite number ($170B+X), turning it into a smoke puff, and returns. Assembled by hand as raw text (lowercase 'x'); its operand bytes overlap the start of the next table.

s02A4E9.name: Table: extended sprite hitbox X offsets
summary: Indexed by extended sprite number with base $02A4E7, so this row covers sprites 2-$0B (the bytes before it are the preceding STA and RTS).

s02A4F3.name: Table: extended sprite hitbox Y offsets
summary: Indexed by extended sprite number, sprites 0-$0B.

s02A4FF.name: Table: extended sprite hitbox widths
summary: Indexed by extended sprite number, sprites 0-$0B.

s02A50B.name: Table: extended sprite hitbox heights
summary: Indexed by extended sprite number, sprites 0-$0D.

s02A519.name: Extended sprite hitbox, tile collision, level start
summary: $02A519: builds the extended sprite's hitbox for CheckForContact: $04/$0A = X, $05/$0B = Y, $06 = width, $07 = height. Parameters: X = sprite index.
$02A547: hitbox of extended sprite [Y] as a fixed 12x19 box at (-2,-4): $00/$08 X, $01/$09 Y, $02 width, $03 height.
$02A56E: object interaction. Returns carry set when the sprite's spot (X+4, Y+8) is solid on layer 1 or 2 ([$0E] bit per layer, [$0C]/[$0D] tile numbers). Special cases for Mode 7 boss rooms.
$02A611: tests one layer: finds the Map16 tile, treats tiles below $11 and $D8+ as ledges (top 6 pixels), $11-$6D as solid, $6E-$D7 as slopes.
$02A751 (JSL, called from level loading): resets the sprite load flags, loads the sprites for the starting screens, resets Mario carry state, and spawns Yoshi if he was brought from the overworld.

SpriteSlotMax.name: Table: highest sprite slot by memory setting
summary: Indexed by the sprite memory setting [$1692], 19 entries.

SpriteSlotMax1.name: Table: highest slot for reserved sprite 1
summary: Indexed by [$1692].

SpriteSlotMax2.name: Table: highest slot for reserved sprite 2
summary: Indexed by [$1692].

SpriteSlotStart.name: Table: first sprite slot to try
summary: Indexed by [$1692]; $FF means start from the top.

SpriteSlotStart1.name: Table: first slot for reserved sprite 1
summary: Indexed by [$1692].

ReservedSprite1.name: Table: reserved sprite number 1
summary: Sprite number that gets its own slot range per memory setting; $FF = none.

ReservedSprite2.name: Table: reserved sprite number 2
summary: Sprite number that gets its own slot range per memory setting; $FF = none.

LoadSprFromLevel.name: Spawn sprites from level data on scroll
summary: Called every frame during a level, acts only on even frames. Computes the screen column (or row, in vertical levels) just entering the view, plus an offset from DATA_02A7F6/F9 by scroll direction [$55], and walks the level sprite list at [$CE] (3 bytes per sprite: YYYYEEsy, XXXXSSSS, number).
Stops at the $FF terminator. Used by generators too.

LoadSpriteLoopStrt.name: Sprite list loop: check screen
summary: Reads the next sprite's screen number and skips sprites before the target screen; returns when it passes it.

LoadNextSprite.name: Skip to next sprite entry and spawn matching one
summary: LoadNextSprite advances 3 bytes and counts the sprite, then loops. The code after $02A84C spawns the sprite when it sits exactly at the target column and has not already been loaded ([$1938] flags), marks it loaded, and dispatches on its number: scroll sprites ($E7+), 5 Eeries ($DE), 3 Platforms ($E0), shooters/generators ($CB and up) or normal sprites.

LoadScrollSprite.name: Start a scroll command sprite
summary: Sprite numbers $E7 and up are scroll commands. Unless one is already active, stores the type ([$143E] = number - $E7) and command ([$1440]), runs CODE_05BCD6, then continues with the list. Followed by the special handling for 5 Eeries ($DE) and 3 Chain Platforms ($E0), which are loaded together to keep them synchronised.
